The main takeaway from our work is that

the evolution of the disk galaxy population can be understood in terms of the evolution of individual disks, with a small contribution from halo growth, and that this evolution does not significantly alter the size-luminosity relation for galaxies of fixed stellar mass.

the observed magnitude-size evolution of disk galaxies since z = 2 can be explained by the evolution in the halo mass and SFR, without any need for evolution in disk sizes or star formation efficiencies.
